messages:
alex: Quick bench request — can someone run a focused microbench to measure streaming + funcall overhead for small responses (~30 tokens) vs long (~1k tokens) across batch sizes 1/8/32? Suspect overhead spikes when KV cache flushes. Need numbers for PR #4527 rollout decision.

maria: pinging eng-runtime, any volunteers? I can run infra if you share the command.

sam: I can do an initial run. Which model + quant profile should I use?

alex: Use `redwood/ggml-13b-q4` and the `q4_k_m` profile from bench configs. Endpoint: staging-infer-1. Example cmd below.

alex: ```
./bench/stream_bench --model ggml-13b-q4 --profile q4_k_m --input=prompt_short.json --batch_sizes=1,8,32 --tokens=30,1024 --runs=50 --trace
```

alex: Run two variants for KV behavior: `--kv_prefetch=1 --cache-policy=prefix` and `--kv_prefetch=0`.

jen: noted. I'll run on pool-dedicated-1. ETA ~40m.

sam: also add combos for `--streaming=true --funcall=true` vs `--streaming=false`. Need both.

alex: yes compare four combos: streaming+funcall, streaming-only, sync+funcall, sync-only.

infra-bot: Started job bench-1812346789 on pool-dedicated-1 (id b-987).

jen: first pass results: short tokens (30): streaming+funcall batch=1 median 85ms, batch=8 median 140ms, batch=32 median 360ms. long tokens (1k): generation dominates but funcall adds ~20-30ms extra. CSV uploaded.

alex: upload link and raw traces?

jen: https://s3.redwood/test/bench-1812346789/results.csv and traces: s3://redwood/traces/b-987.zip :thumbsup:

mike: quick observation — 140ms at batch=8 seems higher than I'd expect. Can we check if structured serialization is blocking? Try `--serialize=struct-json` vs `--serialize=plain`.

jen: re-ran with serialize switch. structured adds ~18ms median, peaks to ~60ms at batch32. Looks like JSON schema validation on the runtime path.

sam: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/1890 with logs and perf traces. cc @eng-runtime.

alex: awesome, thanks. Next steps: if schema validation is the culprit, consider making validation async or offloading to a worker. @maria can you add to roadmap and schedule a small perf PR?

maria: added to sprint board, assigned to @sam. Will prioritize after current infra Q1 work.

alex: FYI tagging product for rollout decision. Please add a short note in the PR with the perf numbers.

sam: will open a PR with async-serialize + micro-optimizations. ETA tomorrow.

alex: great — we'll close this thread after PR merged. Thanks all!
